verdict.rationale: First-party docs say ChatGPT can draft and refine documents, presentations, spreadsheets, and PDFs, and that users can request specific changes and download the completed file. Annotations in the artifacts viewer support targeted iterative revisions, such as marking a chart on a slide and asking for a clearer label. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of document/deck creation and export quality.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have the assistant create and iteratively edit documents, presentations, and other files I can export

citations.quote: Draft and refine documents, presentations, spreadsheets, and PDF files. Review the result, ask for specific changes, and download the completed file.
Annotations let you point to a specific part of a file and tell ChatGPT what to change.
Mark a chart on a slide and request a clearer label.
Use ChatGPT Work to turn notes, docs, research, or meeting materials into a structured deck.
